theorem: At q=3 the point-side and line-side dark fifteens are inequivalent twins. Incidence kills both; the Levi graph has exact 30-dimensional nullspace 15_p+15_l. Because the point and line SRGs have different GF(2) adjacency ranks, no incidence-preserving point-line correlation can swap the sides. The minimal honest symmetric dark carrier is the twin 30-space, not a canonical 15-to-15 bridge.
boundary: A nonzero off-diagonal bridge would have to break the live incidence/PSp symmetry or use a larger nonpermutation carrier; none is manufactured here.
